market_signal: PERIPHERAL PRICE EROSION AS GERMANY AND NORTHERN HUBS STABILIZE
market_signal_body: German VEZG holds firm at 1.320 €/kg SG, with Danish Crown (7.50 DKK/kg) and Vion (1.11 €/kg) maintaining stable baselines.\nSouthern markets face renewed pressure: Spain Mercolleida drops to 1.137 €/kg live (-0.031 WoW) and Italy CUN eases to 1.875 €/kg live (-0.040 WoW via 3tres3 secondary fallback).\nFrench MPB recedes to 1.442 €/kg carcass (-0.060 WoW) and Poland Class E softens to 5.66 PLN/kg (-0.04 WoW per POLPIG T45).
takeaways: Germany VEZG stabilizes at 1.320 €/kg SG (±0.000), holding support alongside Danish Crown (7.50 DKK) and Vion (1.11 €).
Spain Mercolleida contracts to 1.137 €/kg live (-0.031 WoW) via validated 3tres3 / vaex fallback.
Italy CUN drops to 1.875 €/kg live (-0.040 WoW) verified through 3tres3 CUN 156/200 kg session fallback.
France MPB declines to 1.442 €/kg carcass (-0.060 WoW); Poland Class E dips to 5.66 PLN/kg (-0.04 WoW per POLPIG T45).
implications: EXPLOIT German/Dutch stabilization (1.32 / 1.11 €/kg) to lock short-term manufacturing pork contracts
CAPTURE cost concessions on Spanish fresh pork cuts reflecting the Mercolleida retreat to 1.137 €/kg viu
ADJUST Italian specialty procurement models down 4 cents following CUN heavy pig easing to 1.875 €/kg
